why.en: The +dnssec flag sets the DO bit, so the answer includes the RRSIG signature next to the A record.
why.hinglish: +dnssec flag DO bit set karta hai, isliye answer mein A record ke saath RRSIG signature bhi aata hai.

expect.en: An A record plus an RRSIG record, and with a validating resolver the 'ad' flag in the header. Keys, dates and addresses vary.
expect.hinglish: Ek A record aur ek RRSIG record, aur validating resolver ke saath header mein 'ad' flag. Keys, dates aur addresses alag ho sakte hain.

title.en: Look at a zone's public keys

why.en: DNSKEY holds the zone's KSK (flags 257) and ZSK (flags 256).
why.hinglish: DNSKEY mein zone ki KSK (flags 257) aur ZSK (flags 256) hoti hain.

expect.en: Two or more long key records beginning with 256 or 257, then protocol 3 and an algorithm number (13 is ECDSA P-256). Output varies.
expect.hinglish: 256 ya 257 se shuru hone wale do ya zyada lambe key records, phir protocol 3 aur algorithm number (13 matlab ECDSA P-256). Output alag ho sakta hai.

why.en: The DS record in the parent zone (.com) is the hash that links to the child's key.
why.hinglish: Parent zone (.com) mein DS record wo hash hai jo child ki key se link karta hai.

expect.en: A line with a key tag, algorithm, digest type 2 and a SHA-256 hash. Values vary.
expect.hinglish: Key tag, algorithm, digest type 2 aur SHA-256 hash wali line. Values alag ho sakti hain.

title.en: Find keys and signatures in the capture
title.hinglish: Capture mein keys aur signatures dhoondo

why.en: Open the lesson's .pcap in Wireshark and filter for the DNSSEC record types.
why.hinglish: Lesson ka .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur DNSSEC record types filter karo.

expect.en: RRSIG (46), DNSKEY (48) and DS (43) records in the responses, and in the tampered capture a reply with rcode 2 (SERVFAIL).
expect.hinglish: Responses mein RRSIG (46), DNSKEY (48) aur DS (43) records, aur tampered capture mein rcode 2 (SERVFAIL) wala reply.
